SCIENTIFIC DESKTOP · DEC 2025 — JUN 2026

EPS QKD — desktop control & analysis

Independently developed a quantum measurement desktop application, bringing live acquisition, interactive analysis, and hardware control into one responsive, installable experience.

PythonPySide6NumPy / SciPy
View project details ↗

The challenge · Lab workflows were distributed across separate tools and scripts.

My contribution · Built threaded acquisition, reusable UI components, analysis and exports, plus simulation mode for offline testing. Validated calculations against reference states and formulas.

The outcome · Unified measurement workflows in a maintainable application and packaged it for Windows installation.

QNTSim — quantum network simulator

Built the QNTSim frontend from scratch: an interactive topology editor, configuration workflows, learning content, and an initial results interface in coordination with the backend team.

ReactTypeScriptCytoscape.js
View project details ↗

The challenge · Researchers and learners needed a practical way to construct and explore network simulations.

My contribution · Developed graph editing, validation, undo/redo, reusable educational templates, and simulation configuration interfaces.

The outcome · Helped extend an early simulator into a broader research and learning application. My scope was the frontend; engine integration was coordinated with the backend team.
